deck_title: Enterprise Architectural & Retail Storefront CAD/BIM-to-Photoreal Visualization Studio: M-LSD Straight-Edge + Surface Normal + Metric Depth Lock + IP-Adapter Material Swatch Bind (c_bim = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Img2Img Wall Warping

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Architectural & Retail CAD/BIM Multi-ControlNet evaluation (extracting M-LSD vanishing-point straight lines, camera-space surface normals, and 16-bit metric Z-depth from Revit/Rhino/SketchUp viewports, conditioning Flux/SDXL via Tri-ControlNet Union with regional Material-ID IP-Adapter swatch binding and 360-degree physical solar relighting so amortized visualization cost c_bim(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_bim = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive unconstrained Img2Img (which bends load-bearing columns and curtain-wall mullions by >2.8 deg, closes egress doors, and mutates brand material swatches, inflating manual rework cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-facet perspective quadrature.

good_fit: Commercial architecture visualization, 500+ retail store spatial rollouts, exhibition booths, and real-estate staging from Revit / Rhino / SketchUp massing models
Combining M-LSD straight-edge locks (<0.08 deg), camera-space Surface Normals, and 16-bit metric Z-Depth with BIM Material-ID IP-Adapter swatch binding
Generating instant multi-time-of-day (Golden Hour, Overcast, Rainy Night) client options without waiting 4 hours per V-Ray CPU render
not_for: Running unconstrained high-denoise Img2Img on architectural CAD elevations where load-bearing columns, mullions, and egress doors must never warp
Replacing certified structural finite-element engineering drawings with artistic renders
Purely abstract fluid art with no rectilinear geometry
